env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd probe
logos test .
logos eject -o $WORK/ejected
cd $WORK/ejected
go test .

-- probe/go.mod --
module example.com/comptimetest

go 1.27
-- probe/fields_test.lgo --
package comptimetest

import (
	"comptime"
	"testing"
)

type Pair struct {
	A int
	B string
}

func TestFields(t *testing.T) {
	n := 0
	var v Pair
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Pair]() {
		_ = v.[f]
		n++
	}
	if n != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("got %d fields, want 2", n)
	}
}
-- probe/xfields_test.lgo --
package comptimetest_test

import (
	"comptime"
	"testing"
)

type Triple struct {
	A int
	B string
	C bool
}

func TestExternalFields(t *testing.T) {
	n := 0
	var v Triple
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Triple]() {
		_ = v.[f]
		n++
	}
	if n != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("got %d fields, want 3", n)
	}
}
